items.title: Hive與Nefilim勒索軟體集團成員遭美國判刑，將入獄70個月
items.summary: 美國司法部於10月27日宣布，36歲烏克蘭籍男子Artem Stryzhak因參與Nefilim與Hive勒索軟體攻擊行動，遭美國法院判處70個月徒刑，他於2021年6月加入Nefilim集團成為附屬成員，使用該集團的勒索軟體發動攻擊，並將所獲贖金的20%交給該集團管理者。

items.title: 年末購物旺季將至，Palo Alto Networks示警零售業面臨多重網路威脅
items.summary: 每年的年底是零售購物的高峰，隨著銷售旺季到來，Palo Alto Networks於10月28日發布報告，示警零售業者與消費者面臨的網路攻擊風險升高，攻擊者可能趁零售業者忙於應付交易高峰、系統更新與調整受限的時機發動攻擊。

items.title: DoorDash砸170億美元收購Instacart，整合餐飲與生鮮外送市場
items.summary: 美國外送平臺龍頭DoorDash周四（10/29）宣布，將以約170億美元收購生鮮雜貨配送平臺Instacart，整合雙方的餐飲、生鮮及零售配送業務，並結合電商、廣告及AI技術，擴大在美國零售配送市場的影響力。有鑑於DoorDash與Instacart原本在美國生鮮配送市場就是競爭對手，此一交易可能引發反壟斷審查。

items.title: 日本航空第三方訂位系統遭入侵，約9.2萬名旅客資料受影響
items.summary: 日本航空（Japan Airlines，JAL）與日本越洋航空（Japan Transocean Air，JTA）於10月28日公告，兩家公司使用的第三方旅客服務系統遭外部人士擅自存取，約9.2萬名旅客的訂位代號、姓名及航班資訊等資料受影響，其中約2,000名旅客的資料還包括護照號碼、電子郵件地址等個資。

items.title: DEVCORE研究員公布在Pwn2Own競賽揭露的Edge攻擊鏈，串連5個弱點突破瀏覽器防護機制
items.summary: 臺灣資安公司DEVCORE首席資安研究員Orange Tsai（蔡政達）於10月28日，公開在漏洞挖掘競賽Pwn2Own Berlin 2026首度展示的Edge瀏覽器完整攻擊鏈細節，過程中只利用邏輯漏洞，不依賴記憶體損毀，成功突破瀏覽器安全防護，最終在作業系統執行任意程式碼。

items.title: fix(cron): failure repair turns can read and fix the job they repair …
items.summary: fix(cron): failure repair turns can read and fix the job they repair (#188105) Related: #161007, #180304, #187346 ## What Problem This Solves Fixes: an automation's failure repair turn cannot read or change the job it was asked to repair, so it asks the user to fix it instead. ## User Impact User impact: when an owned automation fails, the repair turn in its owner conversation can now read the job's runs and update the job when the job's requester is still an owner, so most repairs no longer need a human reply. Scheduler notices about a job follow the same rule. Risk to note: a job whose requester is not an owner (or whose stored operator source can no longer be restored) now gets read-only automation access in its repair and notice turns, and no session-owner fallback. Jobs that record no requester keep the session owner's current access, as other system turns do since #187346. ## Why This Change Was Made System-started turns got their authority from what kind of turn they were: a label match for notices (#180304), a caller rule for completions (#187346, which left cron out), and nothing for repairs, which went through the public `agent` RPC. Any client can send the repair's provenance label on that RPC, so it could never carry authority. Now: - A scheduler turn about a job acts for the job's recorded requester, the same requester and owner check its scheduled runs use (channel sender, profile, or restored operator source). Owner status is rechecked before each owner-only effect. - Repairs run on the host session-event path, like notices and completions. - Every host system turn gets one rule for caller-scoped automation reads; the `sourceTool === "cron"` match is gone. ## Evidence Production repair transcripts (read-only, one Gateway, since the repair feature shipped): 57 repair turns, 3 fixed their job, 28 asked the user. No repair turn ever completed an `automations` call: before 2026-10-19 the tool was absent, then a schema check failed, and since 2026-10-22 all 18 calls were refused by the owner gate. All 3 script-payload repairs were refused. Final-effect test `src/gateway/server-cron-failure-repair.final-effect.test.ts` runs the real repair dispatcher, real session-event admission, the turn's real tool surface and in-process Gateway dispatch into a real `CronService` and its store (model synthetic). Each case reports the tool result and the stored job afterwards: | Job requester | `automations update` | Stored description | |---|---|---| | Channel owner | ok | changed | | Channel non-owner | gated | unchanged | | Channel owner revoked while the repair was queued | turn refused at admission, no tool ran | unchanged | | Channel owner revoked after admission | refused: tool host retired by the config change | unchanged | | Restored Control UI admin operator source | ok | changed | | Restored non-admin operator source | gated | unchanged | | Operator source with its device revoked before the repair | gated (no session fallback) | unchanged | | Operator source device revoked while queued | turn refused at admission, no tool ran | unchanged | Two fixes came out of this proof: - The queued-revocation case first let the update through: the requester recheck read the config captured at capture time. It now reads the Gateway's current config, as completion turns do (`authority.isCurrent(getSessionEventRuntimeConfig())`). - A restored operator source is an owner only when it was a Control UI administrator, matching the job's in-session runs (`session-run.ts`). The non-admin case fails without this rule. On the base commit the file fails (the repair cannot dispatch outside the old lifecycle path); production transcripts above show the base refusal itself. Runtime-error suppression from #162772 is kept: repair session events set a host-owned `suppressErrorDelivery`, so error payloads stay in the transcript and out of chat. The owner-topic Gateway test now has the repair return a provider-error payload and asserts no chat delivery; without the flag that test fails (`prepareSessionEventDelivery` called once). Gateway cron suite (`server.cron.test.ts`): the owner-topic repair and NO_REPLY repair cases drive the real reply runtime; they check the owner topic's session and thread route, repair pending through retries until the turn settles (success and error), one escalation, and that a forged public `cron_failure_repair` label still gets no silence. The monotonic deadline cases in `server-cron-notifications.repair.test.ts` now run against the session-event dispatcher. Focused runs (`pnpm test --maxWorkers=1`, wall time): | File | Tests | Time | |---|---|---| | `src/gateway/server-cron-failure-repair.final-effect.test.ts` (new) | 8 | 34 s | | `src/gateway/server-cron-notifications.repair.test.ts` | 2 | 7 s | | `src/gateway/tool-resolution.exclude.test.ts` | 37 | 9 s | | `src/agents/agent-tools.turn-authority.test.ts` | 14 | 1 s | | `src/gateway/server.cron.test.ts` | 15 | 30 s | | `src/auto-reply/reply/session-event-permissions.test.ts` | 27 | 37 s | | `src/cron/execution-context-admission.test.ts` | 26 | 6 s | The new test file adds about 8 s of test time (eight cases, one shared fixture). `server.cron.test.ts` stays at its prior cost. `oxfmt`, type-aware `oxlint` on changed files, `pnpm tsgo:core`, the `src` test-type shards and the baseline ratchets (`check:test-mock-exports`, `check:max-lines-ratchet`, `check:assertion-safety`, `check:test-timeout-race-ratchet`) pass. Hosted CI and the ClawSweeper review are green on the merged head. Gaps: - Profile requesters reuse the scheduled-run owner check unchanged; channel and operator-source requesters are the tested paths. - The managed tool host used by `openEventToolHost` does not pass `inputProvenance` into tool construction, so caller-scoped reads for non-owner turns are shown in the unit matrices, not this harness (the embedded attempt path does pass it). Follow-up. - Live proof needs a deploy; the next real failing job on a production Gateway will show it. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
